Order explain

Support agents spend several minutes reconstructing why an order is delayed. Add an Explain this order action on the internal order detail screen.

Who

  • Internal support agents who already have ORDER_READ.
  • Customers do not see this control.

Rules

  • Server-side calls use the existing internal LLM gateway. No new model vendor.
  • If the order has no events, show a fixed sentence and do not call the model.
  • The action must not change order status.

Not in this work

  • No customer-facing chat and no email to the customer.
  • No new ECS service.
  • No free-form multi-turn conversation.
